subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should explicitly budgeted `groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile` setups retain tools automatically, or should all users of the bundled row become chat-only unless they separately override compatibility metadata?
rationale: The base-tier failure requires reducing the total requested tokens, but the proposed model-wide capability change affects existing users and the current provider hook runs after the runtime has already decided whether to construct tools.

options.title: Preserve explicit tool use
options.body: Add an effective-model or tool-policy path so an explicit request budget retains tools while the unconfigured base-tier default remains constrained.

options.title: Accept chat-only migration
options.body: Approve the hard tool opt-out and add provider guidance plus focused upgrade proof for restoring tools through explicit compatibility configuration.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit tool use
recommendation.body: Add an effective-model or tool-policy path so an explicit request budget retains tools while the unconfigured base-tier default remains constrained.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and recently maintained the current bundled Groq catalog and model tool-support path.
